name: 左品牌區＋右數欄連結群組＋右下大字標
desc: 滿一個畫面高的頁尾，上半部左右分區放品牌區與數欄連結群組，中段留白，最下方左側是底部列、右側是大字標。
prompt: 建立一個高度剛好一個畫面的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。左右分成兩區，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：左側約四分之一是品牌區，放標誌，下方可放多行次要資訊文字，沒有時省略；右側約四分之三是數欄連結群組，每組是一個小標題加上直向排列的文字連結，小標題明顯大於連結，一欄裡可上下堆疊兩組，也可有只放數個大型小標題作為連結、沒有下層連結的欄。品牌區與連結群組靠上，中段留大片空白，其餘元素集中在頁尾最下方。最下方左側是底部列：上下兩行，上方可放小型文字連結，沒有時省略，下方一行小字；右下放一個大標題作為字標，約佔內容寬度的一半，右緣對齊頁面內容寬度的右緣，底部與底部列大致對齊，完整落在頁面內容寬度內，不超出畫面邊緣。
mobile: 高度改為依內容而定。隱藏連結群組與底部列，只留品牌區、次要資訊文字和大標題，全部靠左、由上往下排列：品牌區在最上方，次要資訊文字在其下，大標題放在最下方。大標題改為橫跨頁面內容寬度，左右緣與上方文字對齊，完整落在頁面內容寬度內，不超出畫面邊緣，不能造成橫向溢出。

en.name: Left brand block + right multi-column link groups + bottom-right wordmark
en.desc: A footer one viewport tall: the upper part is split into a brand block and multi-column link groups, the middle is left empty, and the bottom has a bottom bar on the left and a large wordmark on the right.
en.prompt: Create a footer that fills exactly one viewport, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. It is split into left and right areas, aligned to the page content width: the left area, about one quarter, is the brand block with a logo, and optionally multi-line secondary text below it; omit it when there is no content. The right area, about three quarters, holds multi-column link groups; each group is a group heading followed by vertically stacked text links, with the group heading clearly larger than the links. A column may stack two groups, and a column may also contain only several large group headings that act as links themselves, with no links beneath them. The brand block and link groups sit at the top, the middle is left as a large empty space, and the remaining elements are gathered at the very bottom of the footer. At the bottom left is the bottom bar in two rows: optionally small text links on top, omitted when there is no content, with a line of small text below. At the bottom right is a headline used as a wordmark, about half the content width, its right edge aligned with the right edge of the page content width and its bottom roughly aligned with the bottom bar; it sits entirely within the page content width and does not extend past the edges of the viewport.
en.mobile: The height becomes determined by its content. Hide the link groups and the bottom bar, keeping only the brand block, the secondary text and the headline, all left-aligned and stacked from top to bottom: the brand block at the top, the secondary text below it, and the headline at the bottom. The headline now spans the page content width, its left and right edges aligned with the text above, sitting entirely within the page content width without extending past the edges of the viewport and without causing horizontal overflow.
